rules.message: Must complete viverse-unity-multiplayer bootstrap (Initialize + Init) before using mp.General.
GeneralModule does not require an enable flag in ModulesConfig. It is always active once MultiplayerClient.Init() completes.
The data argument to SendMessage() is embedded directly into the JSON payload. It must itself be valid JSON (an object, array, or quoted string). A bare string literal will break the envelope.
GeneralModule uses source:'bot' (not 'client') in the outbound envelope. This is unique among all multiplayer modules.
Subscribe to OnMessage, OnClientConnected, and OnClientDisconnected before calling SendMessage() to avoid missing early events.
OnMessage fires with the serialized value of the 'data' field from the inbound envelope — not the full envelope. Parse accordingly.
OnClientConnected and OnClientDisconnected fire with the peer's user_id string, not a JSON envelope. No parsing needed.
Do not add transport logic in C#. GeneralModule is a thin passthrough over MultiplayerClient.
To send a plain string value, wrap it in escaped quotes: mp.General.SendMessage("\"hello\""). Unquoted bare strings produce invalid JSON.
GeneralModule already filters self-originated messages before firing OnMessage. No manual self-check is needed in the handler.
